input.name: Ridgeview Firearms
input.text: Welcome to Ridgeview Firearms, Springfield's family-owned gun shop since 1998. We stock handguns, rifles, shotguns and ammunition, and offer gunsmithing, FFL transfers and concealed-carry classes. Owner Mark Ridge is a certified NRA instructor. Visit us Mon-Sat.
